Maharashtra Considers Mandatory DOB on Wedding Cards to Combat Child Marriage

The Maharashtra government is examining a proposal to make the disclosure of dates of birth (DOB) mandatory on wedding cards. This initiative is being considered as a measure to curb child marriage within the state. Minister Aditi Tatkare confirmed that the government is actively looking into this proposal. The move aims to utilize wedding invitations as a tool to ensure compliance with legal age requirements for marriage.
